cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Cities to scan. Empty = all supported cities.

keywords.title: Trade keywords (optional)
keywords.description: Matched against work description and permit type, e.g. roof, solar, hvac, pool, remodel, demolition, electrical. Empty = all permits.

minValuation.title: Min project value (optional)
minValuation.description: Only permits with declared/estimated value of at least this (USD). Skips permits where the city publishes no value.

sinceDays.title: Issued in the last N days
sinceDays.description: How far back to scan for issued permits.

maxPermits.title: Max permits per run
maxPermits.description: Cap on permit rows returned, split across the selected cities. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip permits seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned permits across runs and skip them. Turn on for a scheduled daily lead feed.
